thread_trawl_protocol: PROVEN METHOD (2026-08-11): each capture batch was written up in a Claude session thread that contains the full verbatim transcripts — either seated in the entry-construction code or in the analysis prose. To recover a batch: (1) take the batch date from this queue; (2) conversation_search on the batch's distinctive query terms plus 'TRANSCRIPT' or 'capture'; (3) read_conversation at the hit and extract the transcript blocks verbatim; (4) write them into the entries' transcript fields with meta.transcript_provenance naming the thread and date; never reconstruct, never summarize. The 2026-08-09 batch was recovered this way from thread 2449623a (2026-08-10). Remaining queue proceeds batch-by-batch, newest first. Captures whose transcripts were only ever supplied on other substrates (ChatGPT-side sessions etc.) need MANUS export and are flagged when identified. EXACT-MATCH PROBES (MANUS, 2026-08-11): all MANUS-pasted Google transcripts end with the footer 'AI can make mistakes, so double-check responses' — conversation_search on that exact string surfaces the paste-bearing threads directly, bypassing write-up threads. A second footer variant exists on some pastes: 'AI responses may include mistakes. For financial advice, consult a professional.' Probe both. DATE-SENSITIVE MATCHING (mandatory): the registry holds multiple captures of the same query at different dates; a recovered transcript is matched to an entry by query AND capture date (thread date bounds the capture date from above), and where the date cannot be established from the thread, the transcript is seated with transcript_provenance noting the ambiguity and the entry match is confirmed with MANUS before write. Never match on query alone. OCR-PROBE CLASS (MANUS, 2026-08-11): for image-bearing captures whose pastes were output-only (input copy blocked), the probe is the capture's own first full sentence, OCR'd from the first screenshot (tesseract, dark-mode inversion, Al→AI normalization; 1.8 s/image benchmarked, full-registry pass ≈10 min). Probe strings are stored per queue row as ocr_probe; exact-match conversation_search on the probe locates the paste-bearing thread even when 'You said:' and the footer are absent. OCR text is for SEARCH ONLY — never seated as transcript; the seated text always comes verbatim from the thread paste.

Standing consequence: from v9.41 the transcript field is a completeness requirement, and the paste is seated verbatim BEFORE any write-up prose is composed.
